compute_psnr: compute the PSNR value between predicted and target tensors with optional masking
compute_ssim: compute the SSIM score between predicted and target RGB images with optional masking
compute_psnr_from_mse: compute the PSNR value from a given MSE tensor using the log formula
save_rendered_img: save rendered RGB and depth images side by side with PSNR overlay to disk
review_save_rendered_img: review the save_rendered_img function that saves NeRF rendered images with quality metrics
